status: Eligibility screening before classifier predictions. No model outcomes inspected.
dataset: Promise+: A dataset of labeled software requirements
license: CC BY 4.0, verified from official API
underlying_collection: Expansion of older PROMISE_exp. Date identifies this release, not every underlying specification.
binary_mapping_scope: Original functional class F versus the published NFR quality subcategories. This is a documented binary reduction, not native FR/NFR string labels and not security/non-security conversion.
project_partition: Sort surviving numeric project IDs, shuffle once with Python random.Random(42), assign first ceil(projects/2) to test and remainder to optional additional training. No split was selected using scores.
overlap_screen: NFKC/casefold word normalization; top-ten shared word-trigram shortlist with Jaccard >=0.30 and sequence >=0.80 or Jaccard >=0.70. Exclude whole projects with any observed match to all 5936 original records. This is a limited text screen, not proof of complete semantic or project independence.
retained_texts_and_source_labels: Unchanged after removing ARFF quoting and record delimiters; no content repairs or relabelling.
parser: Accept the source's records with or without comma after the closing quote. Count and preserve every unparsed record separately, without guessing its label.
comparison_with_other_candidate: Prefer this original 2024 expert-labelled, licensed release over an old input redistributed inside the 2026 hierarchical multi-label package. Neither candidate has been scored for this decision.
